profile.biography:
With over seven years of dedicated exploration in 3D visualization and computer graphics, I sculpt evocative architectural environments, precision hard-surface machinery, and atmospheric digital spaces. My primary creative toolchain is centered around Blender (Cycles & Eevee), supported by ZBrush for organic forms, Substance 3D Painter for tactile material wear, and DaVinci Resolve for filmic color timing.

I believe in disciplined composition, tangible physics of materials, and quiet lighting that invites contemplation rather than visual noise. Every project is an inquiry into structure, reflection, and form.
profile.introduction: Based in Berlin, collaborating globally with creative studios, independent directors, and visionary brands on 3D concept development and digital artwork.

projects.title: Monolith: Oceanic Brutalism
projects.description: An architectural meditation on weight and reflection. A monolithic modular structure suspended above calm coastal waters, balancing raw concrete with warm copper insets.
projects.detailed_overview: Created entirely inside Blender 4.2 LTS using an iterative boolean-bevel modifier pipeline. Volumetric marine fog was rendered with a heterogeneous volume absorption node setup in Cycles (4096 samples, AgX High Contrast). The reflective water plane incorporates micro-displacement caustics and subtle wave vector displacements.

images.caption: Final Cycles 8K production render with volumetric coastal fog and copper panel reflections
Complementary interior pavilion study highlighting natural directional light through concrete pillars

projects.title: Aero-Tactical Recon Drone V-9
projects.description: Precision hard-surface mechanical study of an autonomous dual-rotor reconnaissance drone with high-torque gimbal camera and carbon fiber framework.
projects.detailed_overview: Modeled with strict quad-dominant topology suited for sub-d smoothing and non-destructive workflow. Mechanical rigging in Blender with inverse kinematics on landing gear dampers and camera gimbal. Texturing authored with custom procedural carbon-weave shaders and multi-channel dirt maps.

images.caption: Studio turntable angle displaying titanium chassis and wireframe overlay aesthetics

projects.title: Nordic Forest Sanctuary
projects.description: A tranquil architectural interior pairing raw cast concrete with Scandinavian natural oak timber, framed by floor-to-ceiling glass looking onto pine forest.
projects.detailed_overview: Focus on physical sky simulation using the Nishita Sky Texture model in Blender. Realistic fabric draping simulated in Marvelous Designer and imported via Alembic cache. Floor reflection utilizes accurate micro-scratched roughness maps for authentic polished concrete response.

images.caption: Main wide shot: Natural light illumination through high-transmittance low-iron glass

projects.title: Vanguard: Nomad Scout
projects.description: Futuristic character concept featuring layered weather-worn garments, modular ceramic armor plates, and tactical thermal optical headset.
projects.detailed_overview: Base mesh sculpted in ZBrush, retopologized in Blender for clean deformation topology. High-frequency skin pores and cloth micro-fibers baked down into 32-bit float displacement maps. Shader network utilizes multi-layer subsurface scattering in Blender Cycles.

images.caption: Full-length hero render under cold industrial key light and warm secondary rim lights
